directives.rule: Technical crop validity is insufficient; framing must preserve subject reading, axis, scale and editorial intent. Bad representative video frames must be rejected and resampled.
Stamp, frame and identity overlays must be applied over image pixels and inside the image bounds, never as automatic exterior decoration; they still may not cover protected tattoo regions.
External textured borders and texture filler bands are forbidden by default.
Brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness and temperature must be source-adaptive and conservatively bounded rather than fixed global presets.
Video/Reels are the primary development and learning priority for social media; photo/carousel remains supported.
External profiles can teach abstract editing features but may not authorize copying creator identity, pixels, exact compositions, or overriding FOUNDATION.
